definitions.national_arrivals: Inbound overnight and same-day visitor trips, including nonresident Jordanians; not domestic tourism and not unique people. Underlying official estimates are preserved before display rounding.
definitions.site_visits: Admissions/visits to each reported site; a person can visit multiple sites.
definitions.hotel_arrivals: Guest check-ins at the covered tourist accommodation establishments; distinct from border arrivals.
definitions.regions: MoTA reporting locations, not interchangeable with administrative governorates.
definitions.missing: A blank published value remains null; no geographic allocation or missing-value imputation is performed.
